name: New Town Villages
description: The arcade, also known as gallery house, shophouse or five-legged building, is a modern commercial and residential building. The bottom floor of the building has a hollow and covered public pedestrian space. The ground space can be used for commercial purposes, and the superstructure can be used for habitation. The arcade in the modern sense originated in Beniapukur, India. It was first built by the British. The local dialect is called eranda.
